families.name: CONTRIBUTOR_ROLE_TAXONOMY
families.architecture_effect: Separate human conceptual origin from AI processing, validation, writing, and supervision.

families.name: AI_USE_DISCLOSURE_AND_HUMAN_RESPONSIBILITY
families.architecture_effect: Record tool purpose and retain human responsibility without assigning human semantic origin to GPT.

families.name: QUALITATIVE_REPORTING_AND_REFLEXIVITY
families.architecture_effect: Represent dual roles, recording, derivation, validation, quotations, and limitations.

families.name: ORIGINAL_RECORDING_AND_TRANSCRIPT_PRESERVATION
families.architecture_effect: Preserve original bytes, review transcripts, document processing and differences.

families.name: SOURCE_OFFSETS_TIMESTAMPS_AND_UNCERTAINTY
families.architecture_effect: Require exact source locations and preserve uncertainty without selecting a recording format.

families.name: ENTITY_ACTIVITY_AGENT_PROVENANCE
families.architecture_effect: Use typed entities, activities, agents, derivations, access events, and ordering constraints.

families.name: CONTENT_BINDING_AND_VERSION_IDENTITY
families.architecture_effect: Bind bytes and versions cryptographically while denying that integrity establishes truth.

families.name: DOCUMENTED_HUMAN_AI_ROLES_AND_OVERSIGHT
families.architecture_effect: Define roles, access, knowledge limits, oversight, tests, context, and lifecycle review.

families.name: NON_LEADING_COGNITIVE_FACILITATION
families.architecture_effect: Retain as a future source-bound design family without creating human-facing language.

families.name: SOURCE_GROUNDED_FACTUALITY_DIAGNOSTICS
families.architecture_effect: Represent source support diagnostics without allowing them to replace human semantic attestation.

families.name: WARNING_OR_RESPONSIBILITY_ONLY_AUTOMATION_CONTROL
families.architecture_effect: Do not represent warnings or responsibility instructions as sufficient bias control.

families.name: SOURCE_LINKED_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT
families.architecture_effect: Bind exact derivative, source ancestry, and typed human decision while preserving non-authoritative prior state.

families.name: MULTIPLE_SEALED_INITIAL_GPT_RUNS
families.architecture_effect: Represent separate run commitments and a later reconciliation without claiming independent models.

families.name: MULTI_MODEL_JURY_REQUIRED_CONFIGURATION
families.architecture_effect: No model composition, panel size, or aggregation rule is selected.

families.name: RECONCILIATION_OVERWRITES_INITIAL_JUDGMENTS
families.architecture_effect: Initial judgments and disagreements remain immutable after reconciliation.

families.name: RAW_AND_CLEAN_TWO_FREEZE_GATE
families.architecture_effect: Combine human source preservation, derivative authority states, human decisions, and protected-access gating.

families.name: EXACT_AND_NEAR_DUPLICATE_SEPARATION
families.architecture_effect: Mechanical exact-match and non-binding similarity flags never delete or establish semantic equivalence.

families.name: POST_SELECTION_REVISION_PREVENTION
families.architecture_effect: Preserve chronological versions and force later revisions onto a labeled non-clean branch.

families.name: OWNER_AUTHOR_DUAL_ROLE_CONTROL
families.architecture_effect: Separate owner and author events, prohibit owner adjudication override, disclose single-author limits.
